# [STORY] As an operator, I want facade cache hardening and load-tested SLOs, so that the read-through cache stays correct and fast under real concurrent traffic

## User Story
**As an** operator
**I want** facade cache hardening and load-tested SLOs
**So that** the read-through cache stays correct and fast under real concurrent traffic

## Parent Epic
Parent: #39

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given many concurrent requests miss the cache for the same key, when single-flight is active, then only one upstream call happens, not a thundering herd
- [x] Given Gatling load tests run, when traffic hits the target SLOs, then the results confirm it or flag the regression
